verdict.rationale: Honeybadger offers some ways to get data out: a Faults API that lists faults per project, Insights data replication for Business and Enterprise accounts (the changelog snippet is truncated, so the destination and format are unclear), and BadgerQL queries over event data via the MCP server. There is no documented complete, self-serve bulk export in an open format. missing for 10: documented full-account bulk export, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV dumps of errors, notices, Insights and uptime data), replication on all plans, offboarding/data-portability documentation, independent corroboration.
